title: Are two bogie-hearth furnaces enough to anneal 500 tonnes of steel parts per month?
summary: Monthly output needs calculation from actual batch loading and the complete furnace cycle. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s 22A steel annealing proposal dated 7 August 2023 addresses a 500 t/month requirement with two bogie-hearth furnaces, five pieces per furnace and approximately 2–2.2 t per piece. This supports initial selection, but “two furnaces, five pieces each” does not establish 500 t/month production.
